SERVICE_HEADLINE: OEM parts without the dealer invoice
TAGLINE: A specialist brake shop on Ventura Boulevard fitting the same manufacturer parts the dealership uses, at a price that is not the dealership's.
SERVICES_INTRO: Brakes are the specialism, and the rest of what makes a car stop and steer properly comes with it.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Pads, rotors, calipers and lines, using OEM parts rather than the cheapest equivalent.
SERVICE_2_BODY: The noises and pulling that usually arrive alongside worn brakes. Diagnosed together.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Heating, air conditioning and the charging system, so one visit covers more than one problem.
WHY_INTRO: There are other shops within a few minutes of here. This is what a customer actually notices.
WHY_1_BODY: The quote comes before the work, and nothing gets done without you agreeing to it.
WHY_2_BODY: A person picks up during opening hours, and a missed call gets returned the same day.
WHY_3_BODY: Whatever came off the car is there to look at if you want to see it.
CONTACT_INTRO: Call for anything urgent. For a quote or a booking the form reaches the desk directly.
ABOUT_BODY: A specialist brake shop on Ventura Boulevard staffed by certified technicians, fitting OEM parts rather than the cheapest equivalent, at prices below the dealership.
